title: Concept: ASP.NET Core developer exception page disclosed in a response
description: The ASP.NET Core developer exception page renders the unhandled exception, its stack trace, the request details and optionally the failing source lines. It is registered only in the Development environment, so seeing it means the deployment is running with development semantics in front of real traffic.
applicability: Responses from an ASP.NET Core application running with the developer exception page enabled.
risk: Exception details, source paths and request data reach the client; MEDIUM severity because the page is a debugging aid, not an access control bypass.
